'''The Good Night's Ride''' is an [[inn]] in [[Lugard]] run by [[Duranda Tharne]].

Duranda is an eyes-and-ears for the Blue Ajah. [[Siuan Sanche]] goes to see her to get information on where the Blue Ajah went when the White Tower broke.{{ref/book|5|11}}
